controles.affirmation: Depuis juin 2025, Reddit et certains dirigeants sont defendeurs dans une action collective boursiere devant le tribunal federal du district nord de Californie, alleguant des declarations fausses ou trompeuses sur l'impact de Google Search et AI Overviews ; des plaintes derivees ont suivi ; procedure preliminaire, issue incertaine.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 (RDDT_2026-07-31.htm.gz), Note 9 Legal Matters : "In June 2025, we and certain of our officers and directors were named as defendants in a securities class action lawsuit in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California... alleging that we and certain of our officers made false or misleading statements and omissions concerning the impact of Google Search and its AI Overviews feature on our business. The complaint seeks unspecified damages and attorneys' fees. Subsequently, shareholder derivative complaints with similar allegations were filed in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California... Based on the preliminary nature of the proceedings in these cases, the outcome of these matters remains uncertain."

controles.affirmation: En fevrier 2026, l'ICO britannique a notifie a Reddit une amende de 14,5 M£ pour violation alleguee du RGPD britannique ; la societe conteste en appel.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Note 9 : "In February 2026, the United Kingdom Information Commissioner's Office (“UK ICO”) issued a penalty notice under the UK General Data Protection Regulation, which includes a fine of GBP £14.5 million. We are challenging the UK ICO's findings in an appeal of the penalty notice." Facteur de risque : "the UK ICO recently issued a penalty notice to us for alleged violations of the UK GDPR, which we are appealing". L'ATT ne surqualifie pas : elle parle bien d'une amende notifiee et contestee, pas d'une condamnation definitive.

controles.affirmation: Premier exercice complet beneficiaire en 2025 (resultat net 529,7 M$), apres une perte de 484,3 M$ en 2024 et de 90,8 M$ en 2023 ; deficit accumule de 671,1 M$ fin 2025, ramene a 214,3 M$ au 30 juin 2026.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "Net income (loss) was $529.7 million for the year ended December 31, 2025, as compared to $(484.3) million in the year ended December 31, 2024" ; "As of December 31, 2025, we had an accumulated deficit of $(671.1) million" ; resultat 2023 = (90,824) k$. 10-Q T2 2026, bilan : accumulated deficit (214,288) k$ ; resultat net S1 2026 = 456,829 k$. Verification : 671,1 - 456,8 = 214,3.

controles.affirmation: Remuneration en actions de 343,2 M$ sur l'exercice 2025, soit 15,6 % du chiffre d'affaires annuel.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "stock-based compensation expense of $343.2 million" ; CA FY2025 = 2 202 506 k$. Calcul verifie : 343,2 / 2 202,5 = 15,58 %.

controles.affirmation: La publicite represente 94,6 % du CA du T2 2026 (761,6 M$ sur 804,9 M$) ; la quasi-totalite de la valeur contractuelle des accords de licence provient de deux partenaires seulement.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Advertising revenue $761,625" et "Total revenue $804,905" (T2 2026). Facteur de risque : "to date, substantially all of the contract value associated with our licensing revenue is derived from two of our partners, and these arrangements may not be renewed, or they may be renewed based on less favorable terms, such as using fewer services at lower pricing." Calcul verifie : 761 625 / 804 905 = 94,6 %.

controles.affirmation: Via l'accord de vote avec Advance (environ 22 % du capital), Steven Huffman est habilite a voter environ 74 % du pouvoir de vote au 30 juin 2026 ; Reddit est eligible au statut de « controlled company » NYSE.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "We estimate as of June 30, 2026, pursuant to such voting agreement with Advance, Mr. Huffman was entitled to vote shares representing approximately 74% of the voting power of our outstanding Class A and Class B common stock. As a result, we are eligible to be a “controlled company” under the rules of NYSE, which exempts companies from certain corporate governance rules relating to the independence of the Board of Directors and its committees." ; "Advance Magazine Publishers Inc. (“Advance”) held approximately 22% of our outstanding shares of Class A and Class B common stock".
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : le 10-Q ajoute "Although we are eligible to use these exemptions, we do not currently expect to avail ourselves of any of these exemptions." L'ATT ecrit « ce qui l'exempte de certaines exigences d'independance », au present, alors que Reddit declare ne pas se prevaloir de ces exemptions. Ecrire « ce qui lui permettrait de s'exempter » serait exact.

controles.affirmation: Dependance au trafic organique genere par Google : un changement d'algorithme ou d'interface pourrait reduire ce trafic.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, facteurs de risque : "We rely, in part, on internet search engines, such as Google, to generate traffic to our website, primarily through free or organic searches. Search engines frequently update and change the logic and user interface that determine the placement and display of the results of a user's search, such that the purchased or algorithmic placement of links to our websites may be ranked lower in the search results or otherwise less visible in a user's search or displayed along AI-generated summaries or answers."

controles.affirmation: CA genere aux Etats-Unis de 638,1 M$ sur 804,9 M$ au T2 2026, soit 79,3 % ; aucun autre pays au-dela de 10 %.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, revenu par geographie : "United States $638,119" ; "Rest of world 166,786" ; "Total revenue $804,905". Calcul verifie : 638 119 / 804 905 = 79,28 %.

controles.affirmation: Resultat net +183 % a 252,8 M$ au T2 2026 contre 89,3 M$ un an plus tot ; CA +61 % au T2 2026.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, compte de resultat : "Net income $252,848 / $89,297". Revenu : 804 905 / 499 627. Calculs verifies : +183,1 % et +61,1 %.

controles.affirmation: Ratio cours/CA d'environ 11,0x, contre 6,1x pour Meta, 2,9x pour Pinterest, 2,6x pour Match Group et 1,4x pour Snap.
controles.verbatim_source: Aucune source documentaire dans le repo. La source declaree est « yfinance, donnees de marche consultees le 19/08/2026 », qui n'est ni un filing ni un fichier du data-lake : impossible de retrouver ces multiples dans un document verifiable. Aucun element contradictoire non plus (les rapports internes de l'ATT sont coherents : 11,0/6,1 = 1,80 pour « pres du double » et 11,0/2,9 = 3,8 pour « 4 fois plus »).
controles.correction_proposee: Soit figer un extrait horodate de la source de marche dans le data-lake, soit reformuler en ordre de grandeur non chiffre. Une affirmation de valorisation vendue a des investisseurs doit reposer sur une source archivee et rejouable.
